svg.title: Archipelago Crown: a three-way king of the hill map
svg.desc: A water map. Each team holds an island; the hill crowns the central island, reached by one shoal from each base. Islets between the teams carry a geothermal vent and rich metal, linked to both neighbours by shoals. Hovercraft, ships and amphibious units rule; underwater metal rewards a navy.
svg.text: Three-way king of the hill · 20 × 20 map (10240 game units square) · 1v1v1 to 3v3v3
A water map. Each team holds an island; the hill crowns the central island, reached by one shoal from
each base. Islets between the teams carry a geothermal vent and rich metal, linked to both neighbours
by shoals. Hovercraft, ships and amphibious units rule; underwater metal rewards a navy.
Heights: sea 60 deep, shoals 10 deep · islands 60 · the central island rising to 120
Planet Thalassa · a tropical ocean world
Ground: white coral-sand beaches, lush green island interiors, turquoise shallows over the shoals,
Plants: ad0_senegal palms along every beach, kapoktree and ferns inside the islands, orangemushrooms
Features: rocks30_moss as coral heads on the shoals, corbats_dead and corroy_dead wrecks on the
Sky and weather: bright sky, sea haze; wind 8 to 20; tidal 30; tidal power is strong.
Each third is the same, turned 120° about the hill. Heights in game units; lighter ground stands higher.
